summary_en: ONO SOKKI will cancel 200,000 shares of common stock, representing 1.64% of issued shares before cancellation, effective December 10, 2026, to enhance per-share value.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: ONO SOKKI announced the cancellation of 200,000 treasury shares of common stock, effective December 10, 2026. The shares to be cancelled represent 1.64% of issued shares before cancellation. The board of directors approved the cancellation by written resolution under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The company stated the purpose is to enhance per-share value. Post-cancellation issued share count including treasury shares will be 12,000,000.
